name: WH - WF4 Social Carousel Render & Publish

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $input.first().json;
const s = p.story || {};
const totalSlides = Math.max(4, Math.min(7, (p.assets && p.assets.length) || 6));
const slideSubjects = (p.assets || []).map(a => `Slide ${a["Slide Index"]}: ${a.Name || "Visual"}`).join("\n");
const prompt = [
  "You are the lead social editor for WE, HUMANITY, turning a researched story into a high-retention " + totalSlides + "-slide Instagram/LinkedIn carousel.",
  "",
  "Story Title: " + (s.Title || ""),
  "Pillar: " + (s.Pillar || ""),
  "Glance: " + (s.Glance || ""),
  "Explore: " + (s.Explore || ""),
  "Deep Dive: " + (s["Deep Dive"] || ""),
  "Remember: " + (s.Remember || ""),
  "",
  "Planned slide visuals:",
  slideSubjects || ("1 to " + totalSlides),
  "",
  "CRITICAL EDITORIAL RULES:",
  "1. SLIDE 1 (COVER) MUST STOP THE SCROLL: Write a punchy, concrete hook headline (7 to 12 words, e.g. \"Persians moved water 70 km underground with **no pumps**.\") instead of a generic label. Write a crisp 1-sentence subtitle (10 to 18 words) with NO parentheses.",
  "2. VALUE-DRIVEN HEADLINES ON SLIDES 2-" + totalSlides + ": Every headline (4 to 8 words) must deliver a clear payoff or insight (e.g. \"The desert sun couldn't steal a drop.\", \"An **oil lamp** kept the tunnel straight.\"). NEVER use structural labels like \"The Hook\", \"The Problem\", \"Why It Mattered\", \"The Craft & Turning Point\", \"The Breakthrough\", or \"The Legacy\".",
  "3. 30 TO 40 WORDS PER SLIDE, ONE IDEA PER SLIDE: Write 30 to 40 words of complete, punchy sentences per body slide. Never end mid-sentence or with ellipses. Surface the single most surprising concrete detail (like a clever tool, trick, or measurement) on its own dedicated slide instead of burying it.",
  "4. HIGHLIGHT KEY WORDS: Wrap 1 or 2 key words/phrases per slide in **double asterisks** (e.g. **gravity**, **no pumps**, **oil lamps**) so the renderer highlights them in accent color.",
  "5. FINAL SLIDE CTA: Slide " + totalSlides + " carries the core Remember takeaway plus a short \"cta\" field (e.g. \"Save this · Which ancient tech should we cover next?\").",
  "6. CAPTIONS: Write \"instagram_caption\" with a keyword-rich first-line hook, 2 short readable paragraphs, a CTA, and 3 to 5 relevant hashtags at the end. Write \"linkedin_caption\" with a keyword-rich first line and crisp summary.",
  "",
  "Return ONLY valid JSON:",
  "{",
  "  \"slides\": [",
  "    { \"slide_index\": 1, \"headline\": \"...\", \"body\": \"...\" },",
  "    ... exact length " + totalSlides + " (indices 1.." + totalSlides + ")",
  "  ],",
  "  \"cta\": \"...\",",
  "  \"instagram_caption\": \"...\",",
  "  \"linkedin_caption\": \"...\",",
  "  \"x_post_1\": \"...\",",
  "  \"x_post_2\": \"...\"",
  "}"
].join("\n");
return [{ json: { ...p, copyPrompt: prompt } }];
